result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 0 FOUND, 6 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Read-only security specialist assessment of production source; no tests or source modifications. Spring servlet requests can run concurrently, so the category is applicable.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/controller/HomeController.java:26-31,57-60 and src/main/java/com/photoalbum/controller/DetailController.java:21-26: singleton controllers hold final service references, while response maps/lists and request state are method-local.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/service/impl/PhotoServiceImpl.java:28-47: singleton service holds final repository/configuration fields; private allowedMimeTypes list is constructor-initialized and never mutated by application code. Static fields are a logger and constant, not mutable per-request security state.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/service/impl/PhotoServiceImpl.java:82-83,118-120,130-149,160-174: upload result, image buffers/readers, and new Photo entities are local to each invocation; stream/reader resources are not shared across concurrent requests.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/service/impl/PhotoServiceImpl.java:29,199-216: repository-mediated database mutations occur within service transaction boundaries. Transactions are not presumed to serialize find-then-delete: concurrent deletion may yield stale-state/error outcomes, but no balance/quota/ownership invariant, authorization decision, or demonstrated security-critical consistency violation was identified.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/config/SecurityConfig.java:33-42: user-manager configuration creates one administrator during bean initialization; application endpoints do not mutate shared authentication-user state.

Specialist production Java searches found no application thread/executor creation, explicit locks, wait/notify, shared mutable static collections, or synchronization operations with demonstrated missing/incorrect acquisition or release. Framework singleton lifetime alone is not classified as a vulnerability.

src/main/resources/static/js/upload.js:90-133,205-219: asynchronous upload/UI updates may overlap, but no cross-user shared security state or security-critical exclusive-resource invariant was identified.

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
